Messages.Author: Gary Schwartz
Messages.Body:
What happens when a vampire with +1 hand damage has an Erosion played on
him? Does it make their hand damage 0+1 or just 0?

Also, what happens when a vampire with Erosion played on him plays
Torn Signpost?

Gary S.

Messages.Author: The Corrupter
Messages.Body:
On 8 Jun 1996, Gary Schwartz wrote:

> What happens when a vampire with +1 hand damage has an Erosion played on
> him? Does it make their hand damage 0+1 or just 0?

0+1 is correct. (I believe, don't quote me on it).

Jyhad tends to work of a base (examples: base bleed 1, base hand strike
1) and have modifiers to that (+1 bleed, +1 hand damage)

> Also, what happens when a vampire with Erosion played on him plays
> Torn Signpost?

I would say TS overrides Erosion. After all TS makes a base of 2/3
(unless its changed in VTES text)

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Gary Schwartz <schw...@math.uiuc.edu> wrote:
>What happens when a vampire with +1 hand damage has an Erosion played on
>him? Does it make their hand damage 0+1 or just 0?

Their hand damage is 1.

>Also, what happens when a vampire with Erosion played on him plays
>Torn Signpost?

Torn Signpost will override Erosion for the duration.
